[[Captain Besuz]] is a captain in the [[Kournan military]]. He is tasked by [[General Kahyet]] to lead their [[Corsair]] contacts to a rendezvous point in the [[Blacktide Den]] [[mission]].

== Missions ==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Blacktide Den}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Deep Freeze}}
* {{skill icon|Ice Spikes}}
* {{skill icon|Maelstrom}}

== Dialogue ==
:''"You're to come with me. Hurry up! I want to get out of this god accursed bog as quickly as possible."''

== Notes ==
* While Captain Besuz is an [[ally]], foes will not attack or cast spells on him.
* Captain Besuz moves faster than the player, he appears to have at least a 10-20% permanent [[speed boost]].
* He is a [[boss-like foe]].

== Trivia ==
* While leading the party to the meet, he uses the /catchbreath [[emote]] occasionally.
